explanation: Materialize inorder values recursively and require each adjacent pair to be strictly increasing. Inorder order detects ancestor-bound violations as well as direct child violations, and strict comparison rejects duplicate keys.
timeComplexity: O(n²) worst-case time because recursively concatenating/copying inorder lists can repeatedly copy a skew subtree.
spaceComplexity: O(n + h) traversal-value storage and recursion for n nodes and height h.
